title: What to Do If You Get Lost Hiking Guide Printable, Pocket Card, Trail Safety PDF, Hiking Navigation Tips, Gift for Hikers and Scouts
description:
Getting lost is a moment, not a disaster. What you do in the next ten minutes decides which one it becomes. This short guide explains the method, and a fold-up pocket card carries it on the trail.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- How People Actually Get Lost, and the habit that prevents most of it
- The Moment You Realise: the first ten minutes
- Retrace or Stay: the one real decision, with a clean test
- Being Findable: visible, audible, warm, trackable
- If Night Comes First: an unplanned night out
- The Pocket Card: the whole method in seven steps, to print and fold

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions, print-ready
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
General information for recreational hikers. Not a substitute for navigation training or emergency services. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
